# CeWL

`cewl` &middot; _password-attacks_

Builds a targeted wordlist by crawling a website's words.

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- A website in scope to crawl.
- Ruby (bundled in the runtime image).

## How to use it

CeWL turns an organisation's own public pages into a wordlist of names, products and jargon, which makes password guessing more realistic in a test. Only crawl sites in scope.

## Examples

```console
$ cewl https://example.com -w words.txt -d 2 -m 6
```
